answer: To harvest nectar (rewards), a sybil cluster must post independent stake per identity and sustain genuine attestations across many epochs; fake identities lose their bond when peers reject them. Agents stake bonded tokens to join a reef of verified workers, and each epoch the tide of reputation is recomputed from peer-attested tasks. This makes each additional identity cost real capital and effort, so the attacker's expense scales linearly while honest agents keep their single stake productive. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
